author: DrCurry
bodyHtml: You’ve probably heard someone say, “I’m fat but fit.” Several recent studies have suggested this statement could be true. But a new review of existing studies published this week in the Annals of Internal Medicine may put a stop to the rumor. “Healthy obesity” is just a myth, the study authors say. <Click here for the full article>
